name: mem_lmk_dump
desc: 低内存杀手(LMK)状态与配置
cmd: echo '--- lmkd ---'; getprop | grep -i lmk; echo '--- lowmemorykiller ---'; cat /sys/module/lowmemorykiller/parameters/minfree 2>/dev/null; cat /sys/module/lowmemorykiller/parameters/adj 2>/dev/null; echo '--- lmk props ---'; getprop ro.lmk.low 2>/dev/null; getprop sys.lmk.minfree_levels 2>/dev/null
